name: Resolve a message
description: Resolve a unique Graph message item ID from email_message_id (internetMessageId) or email_local_id (NetworkMessageId)

email_local_id.description: The local message identifier mapped from email.local_id (Graph NetworkMessageId)

email_message_id.description: The message identifier mapped from email.message_id (Graph internetMessageId / Internet Message-ID RFC 5322)

item_index.description: Zero-based index of the candidate to select

most_recent.description: When true, sort candidates by receivedDateTime descending before applying item_index

top.description: Maximum number of candidate messages to fetch before selecting one

user.description: The user identifier or user principal name (UPN)
